svg.title: Four multi-agent patterns, and what each cost
svg.desc: A hand-drawn two-by-two catalogue. Orchestrator-Specialist fans one box out to three specialists across a red dashed hand-off line and merges them back: 3.7x cost for plus 2.5 points, 77.5 percent at $0.71. Critic-Refiner loops write and critique around a rubric card: 1.8x for plus 7.5 points, 82.5 percent at $0.34, and it carries the only green tick on the page. Mixture of Agents runs the same task three times into an aggregate: 4.5x for plus 1.7. One strong agent with a self-loop is the 1.0x baseline at 75 percent and $0.19. Below, a shared-context sketch is struck through beside isolated 600-token briefs taking $0.71 down to $0.31.
svg.text: Four multi-agent patterns, and what each cost
